theorem_title: Retained source construction is linear in compact capacity
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceRetainedProgram.time_le_factor {h J cut : ℕ} (hcut : cut ≤ J*(464*h)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceRetainedHost.time h J cut ≤ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceRetainedProgram.factor h J*(_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap (J*(464*h)) cut+1) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For natural $h,J,c$ with $c\le464hJ$, $$\operatorname{retainedHostTime}(h,J,c)\le\operatorname{factor}(h,J)\bigl(\operatorname{downsetCap}(464hJ,c)+1\bigr).$$

This factorization isolates compact-table capacity so the source stage can be charged to the finite encoder ledger.
